fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Single-Diode (electrochemical PV) with Thermal ODE
source: O'Regan & Graetzel (1991) Nature 353:737; Graetzel (2003) J. Photochem. Photobiol. C 4:145; Snaith & Schmidt-Mende (2007) Adv. Mater. 19:3187; Ni et al. (2006) Sol. Energy Mater. Sol. Cells 90:1331

unit.name: Generic N719-dye / TiO2 / I3-/I- redox DSSC, 1 cm2 lab cell

I_L_density_ref.note: Photocurrent density (dye absorption) at G_ref=1000 W/m2, AM1.5G, N719

I0_density_ref.note: Diode dark saturation current (TiO2/electrolyte recombination) at T_ref

n_ideality.note: Diode ideality factor; ~2 for DSSC interfacial recombination (Snaith 2007)

E_g.note: Effective optical gap of N719 dye/TiO2 system (sets I0(T) bandgap term)

Rs_area.note: Series resistance*area: TCO sheet + electrolyte/redox (I3-/I-) ohmic drop

Rsh_area.note: Shunt resistance*area: interfacial leakage / back recombination

j_diff_lim.note: I3- diffusion-limited current density in electrolyte (mass-transport ceiling)

alpha_isc.note: Temperature coeff of photocurrent (+, slight Isc rise with T)

hA_loss.note: Convective+radiative heat loss coefficient*area to ambient

absorptance.note: Fraction of incident irradiance absorbed as heat+photons
